```{python}
#| echo: false

import json
from pathlib import Path

# Lade report_data.json
report_data_path = Path("report_data.json")
if not report_data_path.exists():
    # Versuche im gleichen Verzeichnis wie QMD
    report_data_path = Path(__file__).parent / "report_data.json"

with open(report_data_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Extrahiere Daten
metadata = data.get('metadata', {})
customer = data.get('customer', {})
project = data.get('project', {})
author = data.get('author', {})
models = data.get('models', [])
checks = data.get('checks', [])
language = data.get('language', 'de')

# Übersetzungen
translations = {
    'de': {
        'dashboard': 'Übersicht',
        'details': 'Detailprüfungen',
        'customer': 'Kunde',
        'project': 'Projekt',
        'generated_at': 'Erstellt am',
        'report_id': 'Bericht-ID',
        'models_checked': 'Geprüfte Modelle',
        'check': 'Prüfung',
        'status': 'Status',
        'findings': 'Befunde',
        'pass': 'OK',
        'warn': 'Warnung',
        'fail': 'Fehler',
        'total': 'Gesamt',
        'severity': 'Schweregrad',
        'entity': 'Element',
        'message': 'Meldung',
        'ifc_type': 'IFC-Typ',
        'storey': 'Geschoss',
        'building': 'Gebäude',
        'no_findings': 'Keine Befunde',
        'summary': 'Zusammenfassung'
    },
    'en': {
        'dashboard': 'Overview',
        'details': 'Detailed Checks',
        'customer': 'Customer',
        'project': 'Project',
        'generated_at': 'Generated at',
        'report_id': 'Report ID',
        'models_checked': 'Models Checked',
        'check': 'Check',
        'status': 'Status',
        'findings': 'Findings',
        'pass': 'OK',
        'warn': 'Warning',
        'fail': 'Error',
        'total': 'Total',
        'severity': 'Severity',
        'entity': 'Entity',
        'message': 'Message',
        'ifc_type': 'IFC Type',
        'storey': 'Storey',
        'building': 'Building',
        'no_findings': 'No findings',
        'summary': 'Summary'
    },
    'fr': {
        'dashboard': 'Vue d\'ensemble',
        'details': 'Vérifications détaillées',
        'customer': 'Client',
        'project': 'Projet',
        'generated_at': 'Généré le',
        'report_id': 'ID du rapport',
        'models_checked': 'Modèles vérifiés',
        'check': 'Vérification',
        'status': 'Statut',
        'findings': 'Résultats',
        'pass': 'OK',
        'warn': 'Avertissement',
        'fail': 'Erreur',
        'total': 'Total',
        'severity': 'Gravité',
        'entity': 'Entité',
        'message': 'Message',
        'ifc_type': 'Type IFC',
        'storey': 'Niveau',
        'building': 'Bâtiment',
        'no_findings': 'Aucun résultat',
        'summary': 'Résumé'

}

t = translations.get(language, translations['de'])

# Hilfsfunktionen
def get_status_symbol(status):
    if status == 'pass':
        return '✓'
    elif status == 'warn':
        return '⚠'
    elif status == 'fail':
        return '✗'
    return '?'

def format_datetime(dt_str):
    from datetime import datetime
    try:
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(dt_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        return dt.strftime('%d.%m.%Y %H:%M')
    except:
        return dt_str

# Generiere Typst-Code als String
def generate_typst_content():
    lines = []
    
    # Header mit Logos
    lines.append("#align(center)[")
    lines.append("  #grid(")
    lines.append("    columns: 3,")
    lines.append("    column-gutter: 1cm,")
    
    # Customer Logo
    if customer.get('logo_path'):
        lines.append(f'    #image("{customer["logo_path"]}", width: 4cm),')
    else:
        lines.append('    [],')
    
    # Project Logo
    if project.get('logo_path'):
        lines.append(f'    #image("{project["logo_path"]}", width: 4cm),')
    else:
        lines.append('    [],')
    
    # Author Logo
    if author.get('logo_path'):
        lines.append(f'    #image("{author["logo_path"]}", width: 4cm)')
    else:
        lines.append('    []')
    
    lines.append("  )")
    lines.append("]")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("#v(1cm)")
    lines.append("")
    
    # Titel
    lines.append("#align(center)[")
    lines.append('  #text(size: 24pt, weight: "bold")[IFC Validierungsbericht]')
    lines.append("]")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("#v(0.5cm)")
    lines.append("")
    
    # Metadaten
    lines.append("#grid(")
    lines.append("  columns: 2,")
    lines.append("  column-gutter: 1cm,")
    lines.append(f'  [#text(weight: "bold")[{t["customer"]}]: {customer.get("name", "N/A")}]')
    lines.append(f'  [#text(weight: "bold")[{t["generated_at"]}]: {format_datetime(metadata.get("generated_at", ""))}]')
    lines.append(f'  [#text(weight: "bold")[{t["project"]}]: {project.get("name", "N/A")}]')
    lines.append(f'  [#text(weight: "bold")[{t["report_id"]}]: {metadata.get("report_id", "N/A")}]')
    lines.append(")")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("#v(1cm)")
    lines.append("")
    
    # Übersichtstabelle
    lines.append("#table(")
    lines.append("  columns: 4,")
    lines.append("  align: center,")
    lines.append("  stroke: 1pt,")
    lines.append(f'  [*{t["check"]}*], [*{t["status"]}*], [*{t["findings"]}*], [*{t["total"]}*],')
    
    for check in checks:
        status_sym = get_status_symbol(check.get('status', ''))
        total = check.get('summary', {}).get('total', 0)
        title = check.get('title', '').replace('"', '\\"')
        lines.append(f'  ("{title}", "{status_sym}", {total}, {total}),')
    
    lines.append(")")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("#pagebreak()")
    lines.append("")
    
    # Detailprüfungen
    for check in checks:
        title = check.get('title', '').replace('"', '\\"')
        desc = check.get('description', '').replace('"', '\\"')
        status = check.get('status', '')
        status_sym = get_status_symbol(status)
        summary = check.get('summary', {})
        scoped_models = ', '.join(check.get('scoped_models', []))
        findings = check.get('findings', [])
        
        lines.append(f'#heading(level: 1)[{title}]')
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f'{desc}')
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("#v(0.5cm)")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("#block(")
        lines.append('  fill: luma(240),')
        lines.append('  padding: 0.5cm,')
        lines.append('  radius: 0.2cm')
        lines.append(")[")
        lines.append(f'  #text(weight: "bold")[{t["status"]}]: "{status_sym}" {status.upper()}')
        lines.append("  #linebreak()")
        lines.append(f'  #text(weight: "bold")[{t["summary"]}]:')
        lines.append(f'  - {t["pass"]}: {summary.get("pass", 0)}')
        lines.append(f'  - {t["warn"]}: {summary.get("warn", 0)}')
        lines.append(f'  - {t["fail"]}: {summary.get("fail", 0)}')
        lines.append(f'  - Info: {summary.get("info", 0)}')
        lines.append("]")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("#v(0.5cm)")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f'#text(weight: "bold")[{t["models_checked"]}]: {scoped_models}')
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("#v(0.5cm)")
        lines.append("")
        
        if findings:
            lines.append("#table(")
            lines.append("  columns: (auto, 1fr, auto, auto, auto),")
            lines.append("  align: left,")
            lines.append("  stroke: 1pt,")
            lines.append(f'  [*{t["severity"]}*], [*{t["message"]}*], [*{t["ifc_type"]}*], [*{t["storey"]}*], [*{t["building"]}*],')
            
            for finding in findings:
                severity = finding.get('severity', '').upper()
                message = finding.get('message', '').replace('"', '\\"')
                ifc_type = finding.get('ifc_type', '-')
                storey = finding.get('storey', '-')
                building = finding.get('building', '-')
                lines.append(f'  ("{severity}", "{message}", "{ifc_type}", "{storey}", "{building}"),')
            
            lines.append(")")
        else:
            lines.append(f'#text(style: "italic")[{t["no_findings"]}]')
        
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("#pagebreak()")
        lines.append("")
    
    return '\n'.join(lines)

typst_content = generate_typst_content()
```

`r typst_content`
